surface: Business Flow CLI to verified standalone HTML

cases.behavior: A Business Flow without layout_direction remains byte-identical to the committed fixed-grid legacy artifact.
An explicit long horizontal flow is delivered with increasing left-to-right slots, adaptive width, showcase checks, and deterministic bytes.
assertions: real CLI deliver exits zero and receipt is ok
viewBox width exceeds the legacy 1380px floor
a repeated delivery produces identical HTML bytes

cases.behavior: The checked-in vertical sample delivers branch, merge, cross-lane, and return semantics with bottom-to-top forward normals.
assertions: real CLI deliver exits zero and all showcase checks pass
branch, merge, cross-lane, and return relationship identities are present
the cross-lane forward edge leaves downward and enters the target top from above

cases.behavior: An unmarked forward cycle fails closed with a structured forward-cycle diagnostic and no valid artifact.

boundary: Local Node.js CLI and self-contained HTML only; this DELTA suite makes no release-level, browser-matrix, hosted-service, or production claim.
